name: 丁玮 - 建筑设计作品集
title: 建筑师 | Architect
bio: 一名专注于城市建筑与空间设计的建筑师。
bioEn: An architect focused on urban architecture and spatial design.
description: 我相信伟大的建筑能够讲述故事，并将人们与环境相连接。
descriptionEn: I believe great architecture tells stories and connects people with their environment.

about.title: 关于我
about.content: 丁玮，建筑学硕士，国家一级注册建筑师。现就职于成都市建筑设计研究院，专注于城市更新、公共建筑与居住建筑的设计与研究。
about.contentEn: Ding Wei, Master of Architecture, National First-Class Registered Architect. Currently working at Chengdu Architectural Design and Research Institute, focusing on urban renewal, public architecture, and residential building design and research.
about.philosophy: 我的设计理念是将功能性与美学完美结合，关注建筑与城市文脉的对话，追求可持续发展的设计原则。
about.philosophyEn: My design philosophy is to perfectly integrate functionality and aesthetics, focusing on the dialogue between architecture and urban context, pursuing sustainable design principles.

contact.title: 联系我
contact.subtitle: 有合作意向或想了解更多信息？欢迎与我联系
contact.subtitleEn: Interested in collaboration or want to know more? Feel free to get in touch

projects.title: 居住区设计
projects.description: 现代简约风格的居住区设计，注重人与自然的和谐共处
projects.descriptionEn: Modern and simple style residential design, emphasizing harmony between people and nature
projects.details: 本项目位于成都市怡丰花园片区，设计理念强调社区共享空间与私密居住的平衡。整体规划采用组团式布局，通过绿化走廊串联各个功能区块。建筑立面采用暖色调材料，营造温馨的居住氛围。景观设计融入成都地域特色，设置了多处休闲广场和儿童活动空间，旨在打造一个生态宜居的现代化社区。
projects.detailsEn: This project is located in the Yifeng Garden area of Chengdu. The design concept emphasizes the balance between community shared spaces and private living. The overall planning adopts a cluster layout, connecting various functional blocks through green corridors.

projects.title: 城市设计
projects.description: 城市更新与公共空间活化设计
projects.descriptionEn: Urban renewal and public space activation design
projects.details: 高攀路城市设计项目聚焦于街道空间的活化与社区活力的提升。设计策略包括：优化步行系统，扩宽人行道并设置休憩设施；增加街道绿化密度，种植本土植物品种；重新规划沿街商业界面，打造连续的活力界面；引入艺术装置和文化元素，提升街道的识别性和文化内涵。
projects.detailsEn: The Gaopan Road urban design project focuses on street space activation and community vitality enhancement.

projects.title: 城市更新
projects.description: 历史街区的保护性更新与文化传承
projects.descriptionEn: Protective renewal and cultural inheritance of historic districts
projects.details: 玉林路城市更新项目在保留历史肌理的同时，注入新的功能与活力。设计遵循"保护为主、活化利用"的原则，对原有建筑进行修缮加固，保留具有历史价值的建筑元素。同时引入文创产业、特色餐饮等新业态，让老街区焕发新生。
projects.detailsEn: The Yulin Road urban renewal project preserves the historical texture while injecting new functions and vitality.

projects.title: 大学图书馆
projects.description: 现代校园文化地标建筑
projects.details: 四川大学望江校区图书馆设计融合传统与现代，创造知识共享的空间。建筑设计取意于"竹简"与"书卷"，立面采用参数化设计的遮阳百叶，形成有韵律的光影效果。内部空间采用开放式布局，设置多种学习区域满足不同需求。
projects.detailsEn: The Sichuan University Wangjiang Campus Library design integrates tradition and modernity, creating a space for knowledge sharing.
